title: a scope or authority stop never rotates runtime
proves: an exhaustion envelope whose error code is one the node owns rather than the network or the provider's quota (NON_FAILOVER_CODES in backoff.mjs — here authority_denied, an authority stop) is settled straight to exhausted on the runtime that produced it: handleProviderExhaustion returns before classifyTransition or planRoute ever run, so no routing-history hop is recorded and the runtime's own declared fallback, though present and reachable, is never dispatched. A run whose worker runtime declares a fallback but whose only recorded invocation is the primary is the proof that no rotation happened.

contract.goal: prove an authority stop settles exhausted without ever rotating to the declared fallback runtime
